lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you for calling, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hello, I was promised a refund ten days ago and I want to check the status of my refund. I am getting worried.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I understand your concern, let me check the refund status for you right now.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thank you. The order number is three one one eight.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The refund was processed yesterday. It is on its way to your bank and should appear within two days.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Oh good, that is a relief. Thank you for checking.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Happy to help. Is there anything else?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, that is all. Thanks again.
